content: Type of param I Upstream requirements: SRS_Rte_00072, SRS_Rte_00029 The type for a <param> shall be the ArgumentDataPrototype ’s Implementa- tionDataType if • the serverArgumentImplPolicy is set to useArgumentType AND • the RunnableEntityArgument does not references an Implementation- DataType AND • no mapping to a BswModuleEntry is defined for the RunnableEntity .
